items.title: Major Thanksgiving storm brings flooding, flight delays across US
items.summary: Almost one million customers in the US had no power on Thursday evening as storms descended on both US coasts, bringing wind gusts, heavy rain and flooding.
items.imageAlt: Major Thanksgiving storm brings flooding, flight delays across US

items.title: Justice must serve the people, legal leaders say as Singapore marks 200 years of rule of law
items.summary: “Justice must make a meaningful difference to people's lives,” says Law Minister Edwin Tong, as Singapore's legal and judiciary leaders reflect on access to law and challenges ahead.
